description: Real-Time Proximity Social Discovery — no swipe, no match request. Open chat immediately. Audio/video calls enabled once the other party has replied at least once.

stack.auth: Passwordless: Firebase Phone OTP (SMS) + Firebase Google Sign-In + custom Email OTP (6-digit via Resend) → custom JWT
stack.ai: Anthropic Claude API or OpenAI GPT-4o
stack.storage: Google Cloud Storage (GCS) — signed URLs for all media

coreMechanic.summary: No swipe. No match request. Person A taps a profile → chat opens immediately. Audio/video call buttons are VISIBLE immediately but DISABLED until Person B sends their first reply. Enforced server-side — no paid override, no bypass.
coreMechanic.callEnableRule: Calls are enabled once the non-initiating user has sent at least one message. Tracked via aHasReplied/bHasReplied on the Conversation model. Call buttons always visible in UI; only disabled before first reply. No paid override.

freeInteractionCap.description: Free users can interact with a maximum of 20 unique people (lifetime cap, not daily)
countsAs: sending first message to a new person
freeInteractionCap.doesNotCount: subsequent messages or calls to already-interacted people

callTimeLimits.freeTracking: deducted real-time server-side; call ended server-side when limit reached

gridRankingAlgorithm.important: Ranking NEVER differentiates by gender identity or sexual orientation.
gridRankingAlgorithm.visibilityRule: Users inactive for more than 14 days (lastActiveAt < now - 14d) are hidden from discovery, grid, nearby, recommendations. Enforced via DB query filter, not isOnGrid flag. isOnGrid=false is only for manual panic-hide.

orientationGridLogic.notes: Grid visibility based on WHO THEY WANT TO SEE and WHO WANTS TO SEE THEM.
rules: Straight man → grids of women who want to see men
Gay man → grids of men who want to see men
Lesbian woman → grids of women who want to see women
Bisexual → all matching grids by default

safetySystem.goldenRule: Call buttons are always VISIBLE but DISABLED until the other party has sent at least one message. Tracked via aHasReplied / bHasReplied on Conversation. No paid override. No bypass.

blockingSystem.mutualVisibility: Fully mutual — if A blocks B, B also cannot see A in any listing (grid, search, nearby, likes, matches, profile views, recommendations)
blockingSystem.conversationHiding: Block immediately sets aIsHidden=bIsHidden=true on the conversation; conversation disappears from both users' inboxes. Messages preserved in DB for moderation. Visibility restores if block is removed.
blockingSystem.utility: isBlocked(userAId, userBId) checks both directions. Every user-listing query must filter blocked users.

safetySystem.panicHide: One tap sets isOnGrid=false + pauseIncomingMessages=true. Reversible. Chats preserved.

flow.phone: Firebase Phone Auth SMS → Firebase ID token (carries phone_number) → POST /api/v1/auth/firebase → NearMe JWT. Sets phoneVerified=true.
flow.google: Firebase Google Sign-In → Firebase ID token (carries email) → POST /api/v1/auth/firebase → NearMe JWT. Sets emailVerified per token.
flow.email: POST /api/v1/auth/email/send-otp → POST /api/v1/auth/email/verify-otp → NearMe JWT directly (no Firebase involved). Sets emailVerified=true.

auth.verifiedGate: bearer+verified = valid accessToken AND (phoneVerified=true OR emailVerified=true)
auth.notes: isVerified = phoneVerified OR emailVerified (changed from AND with faceVerified, which is removed). Discovery (grid/explore) shows users with phoneVerified OR emailVerified.

endpoints.notes: UserCard fields: profilePhoto, firstName, age, distance, distanceLabel, lastActiveAt (human-readable), isVerified, isOnline (boolean, false when hideActiveStatus is on), hasLocation (boolean — true when the candidate was found via the Redis geo index rather than the DB fallback pass; used by the client to decide whether a map marker can be placed, since exact lat/lng is never returned), height, weight, bodyType, skinTone, aboutMe, whereAreYouFrom, relationshipStatus, lookingFor, whereWeCanMeet, preferences, fantasyTags, tribes, tags, isShortlisted, isLiked, boosted, rightNowStatus, rightNowCategory, rightNowActive. Ranking is a weighted score, not a plain sort: boosted/spotlight add-ons score by tier (boost_local +8,000,000 / boost_extended +9,000,000 / boost_city_wide +10,000,000 / mega_boost +11,000,000 / spotlight +12,000,000) > platinum (+5,000,000) > gold (+2,000,000) > premium (+1,000,000) > free (+0), plus up to 500,000 pts for distance (0m=max, 100km=0), up to 100,000 pts for profileCompletenessScore, up to 50,000 pts for historicalReplyRate — so Platinum candidates outrank lower tiers across every page, not just within one page. If Redis has no geo hit for the caller's radius (no location synced yet, sparse area), the endpoint falls back to a DB-only candidate pool instead of returning an empty grid; those cards have distanceLabel=null. Candidates with hideExactDistance=true (Gold+) show distanceLabel='Near you' instead of a real distance.

Leave a room (delete RoomMember, decrement memberCount). Emits room:member_left.
Cursor-paginated room messages, newest first. Marks the room read (newest page). Each message carries a sender UserCard (username=firstName; never phone), reactions, replyTo (content truncated 60).

Omitting type returns all messages with a mediaUrl. Each item is a RoomMessageCard (signed mediaUrl, sender UserCard). Cursor paginates by createdAt, newest first.

endpoints.summary: Post a message. Text messages require non-empty content (max 1000); image/GIF messages require mediaUrl and may send empty content. Updates room.lastActivityAt, emits room:message, batch push to non-muted members. mediaUrl accepts an R2 key or hosted URL (image/voice/gif).

fields.name: content
fields.notes: max 1000; required for text, optional/empty for image

fields.name: mediaUrl
fields.notes: required when type=image (GCS path or external URL e.g. Tenor GIF)

fields.notes: added 20260725; opaque JSON blob (max 4000 chars), e.g. voice-note waveform amplitudes {amplitudes:number[]}. Never moderated/content-rule-checked and never rendered as message text (unlike content) — stored/returned verbatim, null when message isDeleted.

"Delete for me" — hides a room message from the caller's own view only (RoomMessage.hiddenForUserIds). Any member. No socket broadcast (only the caller's view changes).
Edit own room message — text only, within a 5-minute window, same content-rule + AI moderation gates as sendMessage. Emits room:message_edited to the room.
Forward a room message into one or more of the caller's own 1:1 conversations. Room 'system' messages cannot be forwarded (400). Emits message.created to each target conversation's other participant.
Edit a room's name/description. Caller must be the room creator or a room admin. Emits room:info_updated to room:{roomId}.

body.name: description
body.notes: max 500 chars; at least one of name/description required

endpoints.summary: Pin or unpin a message. Caller must be the room creator or a room admin (membership required). Emits room:message_pinned to room:{roomId}.

Remove a member from a room. Caller must be the room creator or a room admin. Cannot remove the creator; cannot remove yourself (use DELETE /api/rooms/:roomId/join). Decrements memberCount and emits room:member_removed to room:{roomId}.
Promote/demote a member between admin and member. Caller must be the room creator (creator-only). Cannot change the creator's own role. Emits room:member_role_changed to room:{roomId}.
Change the group photo. Admin or creator only. Body {photoUrl} (R2 key or hosted URL). Updates Room.coverImageUrl, emits room:info_updated {coverImageUrl}.
Transfer ownership to another member. Creator only. Demotes current creator to admin, promotes target to admin, sets Room.creatorId=target. Emits room:ownership_transferred {newCreatorId}.
Delete the group and all child records (RoomMessage, RoomMember, RoomMessageReaction, RoomMessageDelivery, RoomReport, RoomMute). Creator only. Emits room:deleted {roomId}. Returns 204.

Add a user to a room directly (if target.groupsAvailable) or send a room invite (if target not groupsAvailable but a conversation exists between requester and target). Requester must be a room member.
endpoints.notes: 201 {added:true,method:'direct'} on direct add; 201 {added:false,method:'invite_sent'} when an invite is created; 200 {added:true,method:'already_member'} if already a member; 200 {added:false,method:'invite_already_sent'} if a pending invite already exists; 403 cannot_add_user when target is not groupsAvailable and no conversation exists.

endpoints.summary: Bulk add/invite members to a room (creator/admin only; asserted in the service). Each userId runs through the same invite-or-add policy: groupsAvailable users are added directly, users with an existing conversation get an invite, everyone else (and the requester themselves) is skipped. De-dupes userIds.
endpoints.notes: added = directly joined; invited = invite sent (or already pending); skipped = already a member, not addable (403 cannot_add_user), or an error. Requester must be a room member (requireRoomMember) and creator/admin.

Decline a pending invite (invitee only). Sets status=declined.
Cancel an outgoing invite (inviter only). Soft-deletes by setting status=declined. Returns 204.

Get a presigned R2 upload URL for direct client→R2 upload (also aliased at /api/v1/me/photos/upload-url). Client PUTs bytes to uploadUrl with the matching Content-Type, then stores mediaUrl (or key) on the target record/message. No bytes pass through the API.

query.name: contentType
query.notes: Content-Type to sign the PUT with (must match the client's PUT header). Falls back to a per-type default.

endpoints.returns: { uploadUrl: string, key: string, mediaUrl: string, expiresAt: iso8601 }
endpoints.notes: mediaUrl = MEDIA_BASE_URL + '/' + key when configured, else the raw key (signUrl presigns it on read). External URLs (e.g. Tenor GIFs) are stored verbatim and pass through signUrl unchanged.

Forward a message into one or more of the caller's other conversations. Verifies the caller is a participant of every target conversation; creates a copy of the message (isForwarded=true, forwardedFromId=original id) in each and emits message.created to each target's peer.

notes: Socket.IO: connect with io(baseUrl, {auth:{token}}) — socket joins room user:<id> on connect.
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. Refresh on 401 via /auth/refresh.

Error envelope: {error:string, message:string, requestId:string, details?:any}. Every request gets a unique requestId (UUID) echoed in X-Request-ID response header. Pass X-Request-ID in requests to correlate logs.
Fuzzy location: API NEVER returns lat/lng — only distanceLabel or 'Near you' for hideExactDistance users.

CRITICAL — Call gate (Change 2): calls enabled when the OTHER party has replied. aHasReplied = User A has sent a message; bHasReplied = User B has. Call buttons always visible; returns audioCallEnabled/videoCallEnabled=false until flag is true. No paid override.

CRITICAL — Blocking (Change 1): bidirectional — if A blocks B, B cannot see A in ANY listing. isBlocked(a,b) utility covers both directions. Conversation aIsHidden=bIsHidden=true on block. Raw messages preserved for moderation.
CRITICAL — Free interaction cap (Change 6): 20 unique people lifetime. Counts first message OR first like to a new person. Subsequent interactions with same person do NOT count. Paid users: no cap.
CRITICAL — 14-day inactivity (Change 4): lastActiveAt < now-14d hides user from grid/discovery/nearby/recommendations. Enforced via DB query filter, not isOnGrid. isOnGrid=false is panic-hide only.

CRITICAL — isVerified: computed = phoneVerified OR emailVerified (face verification removed 20260618). Updated whenever either verification status changes. Returned on ALL user card/profile responses.
CRITICAL — Profile photo (Change 3.2): single optional profile picture. No minimum photo requirement for discovery eligibility.

UserCard response fields (Change 5): profilePhoto, firstName, age, distance, lastActiveAt (human-readable), isVerified, height, weight, bodyType, skinTone, aboutMe, whereAreYouFrom, relationshipStatus, lookingFor, whereWeCanMeet, preferences, fantasyTags, tribes, tags, isShortlisted, isLiked.

Albums (Change 7): /api/albums endpoints. Plan limits: free=1/10, premium=3/30, gold=5/50, platinum=unlimited/100. Photos: JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10MB, AWS Rekognition moderated. Served as signed GCS URLs (15 min expiry). Block check on /api/v1/users/:userId/albums.
Plan enforcement: check user.plan and user.planExpiresAt on every gated endpoint. Expired plan = free tier.
Agora calls: agoraToken generated server-side using AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE (never expose to client). Token expires in 1 hour.
Women safety defaults on signup: verifiedUsersOnlyFilter=true for users who specify gender=woman.
Moderation: AWS Rekognition scans all uploaded photos/clips before publish. Required for all album photo uploads.
AI features: use claude-sonnet-4-6 for icebreakers/reply suggestions/profile optimizer. All opt-in.
Health endpoints (no auth): GET /health → {status:'ok'}, GET /health/live → {status:'ok'}, GET /health/ready → checks DB+Redis, returns {status:'ok'|'error', db, redis}.
Request logger: every response emits structured JSON {requestId, userId, method, path, statusCode, durationMs, plan} to stdout.
Spec: /Users/suryprakash/Project/backend-spec.json (use frontend-from-spec skill to consume).
Auth: Firebase Auth handles identity. Client gets Firebase ID token via Firebase SDK, exchanges at POST /api/v1/auth/firebase for NearMe JWT pair (accessToken + refreshToken).
bearer+verified gate: valid accessToken AND (emailVerified=true OR phoneVerified=true). Google Sign-In users are always verified. Email+password users must verify their email first.

Right Now (IMPLEMENTED): User model adds rightNowStatus (varchar 120, nullable), rightNowCategory (text: drinks|coffee|workout|hangout|other, nullable), rightNowExpiresAt (timestamp, nullable). Set via PATCH /api/v1/me; clear with PATCH /api/v1/me { rightNowStatus:null, rightNowCategory:null, rightNowExpiresAt:null }. Migration: 20260617_right_now_fields. rightNowHosting (boolean, default false, migration 20260809_right_now_hosting) marks the user as hosting; set alongside the other three via PATCH /api/v1/me and reset to false when clearing. Returned on Self and on each right-now feed card.
UserCard (IMPLEMENTED): now includes rightNowStatus, rightNowCategory, and rightNowActive (= rightNowExpiresAt > now()). Status/category are nulled on the card once the status expires.

GET /api/v1/discovery/right-now (IMPLEMENTED, bearer+verified): feed of nearby users (≤100km via Redis geo) with rightNowExpiresAt > now(), isOnGrid=true, lastActiveAt > now()-14d, not blocked, same orientation filter as the grid. Returns { statuses: UserCard[] (each + rightNowStatus, rightNowCategory, rightNowExpiresAt, rightNowHosting), total }.

GET /api/v1/discovery/views (IMPLEMENTED, Gold+/premiumFeature('viewed_me')): { views: [{ id, viewer: UserCard, viewedAt }] }. GET /api/v1/discovery/taps (IMPLEMENTED): { taps: [{ id, sender: UserCard, createdAt }] }. POST /api/v1/discovery/taps sends a tap. DELETE /api/v1/discovery/taps/:userId (IMPLEMENTED) removes a tap (un-fire); returns 204. Emits socket 'tap.received' { tapId, senderId, senderCard, createdAt } to the receiver on send.

GET /api/v1/profile/users/:userId (getPublicProfile) (IMPLEMENTED): now returns isLiked (viewer has an active Tap on this user) and isShortlisted (viewer has a Favorite on this user) so the profile screen renders Fire/Star state consistently with the grid. Still upserts a ProfileView unless viewer is incognito or viewing self.

GET /api/v1/me/photos/upload-url (IMPLEMENTED, alias of /api/v1/me/upload-url): { uploadUrl, gcsPath, expiresAt }. Client PUTs bytes to uploadUrl then POST /api/v1/me/photos { url, isPrimary } (url must be a fully-qualified URL).

Self (GET /api/v1/auth/me) (IMPLEMENTED): now includes primaryPhotoUrl (published primary Photo.url, or null) and callLimits. callLimits = { audioMinutesUsed, audioMinutesLimit, videoMinutesUsed, videoMinutesLimit } for FREE plan only (base 5 audio / 2 video per day + active *_call_topup add-ons; resets at UTC midnight); null for paid plans (unlimited).

Grid query additions sent by the Filters screen (handle server-side on GET /api/v1/grid): gender (csv), relationshipIntent (csv), verifiedOnly (bool, Premium+), activeLast30Min (Premium+), activeLast5Min/recentlyJoined/highReplyRate (Gold+), radius (meters; free ≤25km, Gold+ ≤100km), advancedFilters (JSON string of { education?, occupation?, language?, religion?, drinking?, smoking?, relationshipGoal? } each string[], Premium+).

Dating Rooms (Groups): brand-new module (migration 20260619_dating_rooms). Endpoints under /api/rooms (bearer+verified). Message/member endpoints require room membership (requireRoomMember -> 403 not_a_room_member). Messages run AI text moderation (adapters/moderation.classifyText) -> 451 message_flagged. Unread tracked in Redis rooms:lastread:{userId}:{roomId}. Socket channel room:{roomId}; sockets auto-join on connect for joined rooms. Username in room UI = firstName; phone/email/exact location never exposed.
callHistoryAccess: Premium DOES get call history access (callHistoryAccess=true), matching the PDF feature matrix — corrected from an earlier implementation gap where Premium was set to false.

computeEffectiveLimits() is in backend/src/middleware/subscription.ts (not utils/subscription.ts). Returns EffectiveLimits object. Called by requireAuth middleware on every request (attaches to req.effectiveLimits) and also returned in GET /api/v1/auth/me response as effectiveLimits field.
Message template endpoints are mounted on the conversations router: GET/POST /api/v1/conversations/templates, DELETE /api/v1/conversations/templates/:templateId
Self type = type alias for User. effectiveLimits and callLimits are on User. PublicProfile extends UserCard — does not include these fields.

Room privacy & invite links (migration 20260719_room_privacy_invite_code): Room gained isPrivate (bool) and inviteCode (unique string, generated for every room). POST /api/rooms createRoom accepts isPrivate (default false). Private groups: excluded from GET /api/rooms Discover (where isPrivate:false); POST /api/rooms/:roomId/join throws 403 private_room for non-members; invite-or-add (POST /api/rooms/:roomId/invite-or-add/:userId) and bulk add require admin/creator (assertRoomAdmin) — public groups keep the open member-add policy. Join via link: GET /api/rooms/by-code/:code (preview, no membership) and POST /api/rooms/by-code/:code/join (join; honours isVerifiedOnly; only self-serve way into a private group) — both registered before /:roomId. RoomCard now carries isPrivate; getRoomDetail returns inviteCode only to members (null otherwise). Frontend: create-group/details.tsx has a Public/Private selector; Group Info shows Share/Copy invite link; deep link nearme://rooms/join/<code> -> app/rooms/join/[code].tsx.

FCM push payloads (adapters/fcm.ts buildPushMessage) are typed: new_message, reaction, missed_call, room_message, room_member_join, room_member_left, room_mention. data carries {type, conversationId|roomId} for tap navigation. Push is presence-gated + mute-aware; room mentions (@firstName) push room_mention to the matched member.

Group (Dating Room) calling (migration 20260809_room_calls_notification_prefs): extends the 1:1 Call/Agora architecture to rooms instead of duplicating it. New models RoomCall (roomId, initiatorId, type: CallType, status: RoomCallStatus [ongoing|ended], agoraChannelName, agoraToken, startedAt/endedAt/endReason) and RoomCallParticipant (callId, userId, joinedAt, leftAt) — join table mirrors RoomMember. Endpoints (all requireRoomMember, membership is the only gate — rooms have no block-based call restriction, matching room chat): POST /api/rooms/:roomId/calls {type} creates a new call (broadcasts room:call.invite) or, if one is already ongoing in the room, joins it instead (broadcasts room:call.participant_joined) — idempotent start/join. POST /api/rooms/:roomId/calls/:callId/join explicitly joins an active call (for late joiners reacting to the invite). GET /api/rooms/:roomId/calls/active returns the room's live call + active participants, or {call:null}. PATCH /api/rooms/:roomId/calls/:callId {action:leave|end} — leave marks the caller's participant row left and auto-ends the call (room:call.end, endReason all_left) once no participants remain; end is initiator-only and force-ends for everyone (endReason ended_by_host). Agora channel (nearme-room-<roomId>-<ts>) and token (uid 0, wildcard-joinable) are generated once per call via the existing adapters/agora.ts helpers and shared by every participant. Signaling uses emitToRoom (room:<roomId> socket channel, already joined by every member on connect) instead of the 1:1 flow's per-user emitToUser — events: room:call.invite, room:call.participant_joined, room:call.participant_left, room:call.end. Frontend: call buttons in rooms/[id].tsx header; app/call/[id].tsx generalized to a multi-participant grid (video) / avatar list (audio) when launched with a roomId. Deferred: push notifications for offline room-call invites (online members only, via socket).

Notification preferences now persist server-side (migration 20260809_room_calls_notification_prefs), replacing the previous AsyncStorage-only Settings → Notifications screen. UserSettings gained notifyMessages, notifyPreview, notifySound, notifyVibrate, notifyReactions, notifyMissedCalls, notifyGroupMessages, notifyMemberActivity, notifyMentionsOnly (all boolean, same defaults as the old local DEFAULT_NOTIF_PREFS). Exposed via the existing PATCH /api/v1/me/settings (settingsSchema) and returned by the existing GET /api/v1/auth/me self payload (Self.settings) — no new endpoint. frontend/app/settings/notifications.tsx now loads initial state from me.settings (AsyncStorage kept only as an offline-first cache) and calls updateSettings() on every toggle, optimistic-UI with rollback + toast on failure.

Chat search + shared media are now server-side and cover a conversation's FULL history, replacing the client-side filter/scan that only ever saw the last loaded page. Two new endpoints on the conversations router (backend/src/modules/chat/chat.routes.ts): GET /api/v1/conversations/:conversationId/messages/search?q=&before=&limit= -> { messages: Message[], hasMore, nextCursor } (case-insensitive substring match on Message.content; excludes unsent/deleted-for-me messages and respects the disappearing-messages cutoff); and GET /api/v1/conversations/:conversationId/media?type=&before=&limit= -> { media: Message[], hasMore, nextCursor } where type is image|video|voice|link|document (view-once photos are always excluded). Both require conversation participation (404 otherwise) and reuse listMessages' serialization, so read receipts stay paid-tier gated. NOTE: /messages/search is registered BEFORE the /messages/:messageId routes so "search" is not parsed as a message id. Frontend: app/chat/media.tsx consumes the media endpoint (src/services/api.ts listConversationMedia); searchConversationMessages exists in the client but the in-chat search UI still filters loaded messages only — wiring it needs jump-to-arbitrary-message pagination.

Production hardening pass (2026-08-15). (1) Rate limiting: new backend/src/middleware/rateLimit.ts (Redis fixed-window, fail-open, keyed by user id when authenticated and by IP pre-auth) applied to POST /auth/firebase|/auth/dev-login|/auth/refresh|/auth/email/verify-otp (30/min per IP), POST /auth/email/send-otp (20/10min per IP), all /api/v1/ai/* (20/min per user), GET /me/upload-url + /me/photos/upload-url (60/min per user), POST /api/v1/city-profiles and the message translate endpoint (60/min per user). Set RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED=true to switch every bucket off. (2) Notification preferences are now enforced server-side in services/push.ts sendTypedPush via services/notificationPrefs.ts decidePush — notifyMessages/notifyReactions/notifyMissedCalls/notifyGroupMessages/notifyMemberActivity gate delivery per payload type, notifyMentionsOnly suppresses room_message but not room_mention, and notifyPreview replaces the body of content-bearing pushes with "New message". Mute checks stay at the call sites. (3) modules/common/premium.ts (a no-op passthrough that pretended to gate viewed_me/explore/for_you) was DELETED; those routes now use the new requireCapability(...) middleware in middleware/subscription.ts, which reads the real whoViewedMe / exploreAccess booleans from PLAN_LIMITS. (4) advancedFilters (education/occupation/language/religion/drinking/smoking/relationshipGoal) has no backing columns on User, so the Premium-gated Advanced section was REMOVED from app/filters.tsx and the client no longer sends the parameter; the query param is still accepted and ignored server-side.

Payment-stub safety (2026-08-15). adapters/stripe.ts is still a stub whose retrievePaymentIntent unconditionally returns status "succeeded", and adapters/razorpay.ts falls back to a stub whose verifySignature returns true when RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET are unset. Either path would have let an authenticated caller self-grant a paid plan via POST /api/v1/billing/subscriptions + /verify. Both stubs now throw when NODE_ENV=production, and utils/paymentProvider.detectProvider ignores a client-supplied paymentProvider:"stripe" and returns "razorpay" whenever stripeConfigured is false (which is hard-false in production until a real Stripe SDK client replaces the stub). Regression test: src/tests/rateLimit.test.ts. Also: adapters/payments.ts had zero consumers and was deleted; adapters/aiVerification.ts no longer auto-approves photo verification in production (it records the Verification as "pending" for human review instead of setting photoVerified).

Image moderation is NOT active (2026-08-15). services/imageModeration.ts never had a working AWS Rekognition call — callRekognition always threw, so every image resolved to "allow". The behaviour is now explicit: imageModerationConfigured is exported (hard-false until DetectModerationLabels is implemented), production logs an image_moderation_inactive warning at startup, and the unconfigured result is controlled by IMAGE_MODERATION_FALLBACK ("allow" default, or "manual_review" to accept uploads but leave them unpublished). A configured-but-failing provider now returns manual_review instead of allow. External setup required to activate: AWS account + IAM user with rekognition:DetectModerationLabels, AWS_REGION/AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and an implementation of callRekognition().
